summary.headline: Astrological Questions and Agriculture
summary.text: Catalog entries 571–591 of a Florentine astrological codex, covering questions on ambushes, war, dissolution, travel, ships, bonds, buying and selling slaves, lunar conditions, sowing, planting, and agricultural outcomes, with folio references and cross-references. Authorities and astrological factors include Hermes, Masala, Ares, Zeus, Aphrodite, the Moon, Aries, and Sagittarius.
